MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next step because it adds voice-controlled power for a lamp to my Alexa-enabled setup instead of duplicating something I already own.",
    "The Echo Dot's hands-free control and the HDMI cable's connection to my television and monitor make sense, although neither gives me as concrete a reason to buy now as the smart plug."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both Fire TV sticks repeat a function I already have, and their older or HD capabilities offer little alongside my 4K stick and Fire TV television.",
    "The memory cards and Wi-Fi extender address possible needs rather than needs I have identified: I have not confirmed compatible storage requirements or a coverage problem.",
    "The wired earbuds and older tablet do not support the home viewing and monitoring needs reflected in my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more streaming devices, even when they add no useful capability.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in common accessories, without a clear connection to what I currently need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: an addition that expands my setup is more appealing than another device that repeats an existing function.",
    "Accessories need a specific purpose and confirmed compatibility; owning cameras does not by itself mean I need memory cards or better Wi-Fi coverage.",
    "I choose selectively, so a plausible connection to my devices is not enough without a practical benefit right now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home devices but often confuse useful additions with redundant devices or accessories I have no current reason to buy."
}
